name: referral-decide
description: Flow 11. The underwriter's approve/decline on a referral task becomes ISSUED/DECLINED on decision_config, renders the quotation schedule (or decline notice) and sends the spec section 9 email. Started by a STREAM trigger on ms.workspaces.task.* (microstrate-workspaces), so EVERY task write in the account reaches gate 1 - title edits, assignment, reordering and the flow's own writes included. The trigger body is the partial UpdateTaskRequest and can never carry the record reference, which is why GET_TASK exists. No baseline snapshot: submission v1 IS the baseline (plan section 6.1). Handle precedence is task.source, then task.metadata.decision_id, then task.folder as the pre-migration fallback - contract artefact 4.

Assemble the decision patch, the document payload and the email
